title: 第17章 弗瑞上门第18章 吸血鬼
content_zh:
第17章弗瑞上门
“我们正在调查。”
科尔森一脸笑容的撒谎，他的样子很有欺骗性，托尼没有追问，这时，小辣椒佩珀急匆匆的走了进来。
“看电视。”
佩珀打开电视转到号角电视台频道，主持人詹姆森正在大声介绍：“根据本台得到的消息，昨晚托尼·斯塔克穿着一件可笑的铠甲在斯塔克集团和集团董事奥巴代亚开战……”
在詹姆森说话的同时，画面切换到昨晚的战斗，画质相当清晰，甚至能听到托尼和奥巴代亚的对话。
托尼皱眉：“怎么会这样？科尔森，你们不是说已经解决了吗？”
“技术部已经处理好所有视频，我也不知道为什么会这样。”
科尔森急忙打电话让号角电视台中断节目，可惜，号角电视台没有答应上面的要求，依然在播出。
毫无疑问，这是安德鲁的手笔，他要让民众们知道真相，同时，建立号角电视台的信誉——这有助于将来收集灵魂。
“据我们所知，托尼·斯塔克和奥巴代亚之所以会开战，是因为奥巴代亚长期向恐怖分子出售武器，另外，托尼·斯塔克遇袭，也是奥巴代亚安排的。”
詹姆森滔滔不绝的说着，托尼吐槽道：“这家伙哪来的？他比我这个当事人知道的都多。”
说话的同时，托尼将演讲稿随意的扔在一旁，用不着了，所有人都知道他就是铁人。
电视台继续播出画面，和平骑士团和后面的烈火骑士全都有出场，相当完整。
最后，詹姆森继续道：“很多人表示，他们昨晚拍的视频莫名其妙消失，同时，还有人警告他们，让他们闭嘴。
我完全有理由怀疑，有一个特殊组织正在侵犯公众的隐私权和知情权，我会不惜一切将这个组织挖出来。
另外，快抖app上有大量关于昨晚的视频，欢迎大家下载。”
詹姆森说完，屏幕上出现一个二维码，佩珀和托尼同时拿出手机扫码，科尔森无语，你们要不要这么配合啊？
科尔森头疼地说道：“我们必须重新准备一个说辞。”
“不用了，既然已经被公开，那就实话实说，反正我本来就不想隐瞒。”

托尼说道：“从现在起，我就是钢铁侠。”
科尔森犹豫了下，没有再劝，不知为什么，他突然有一种感觉，一种大幕拉开的感觉。
超级英雄时代，正式来临。
……
重生大厦，安德鲁有些不爽的朝办公室走去，至于苏珊，因为昨晚太累，现在还在沉睡。
安德鲁之所以不爽，不是因为要来上班，而是因为昨晚做了个奇怪的梦。
梦里，一个面容不停变化的小男孩站在类似玻璃的障壁外，朝他不停大吼大叫，似乎很愤怒，但玻璃阻隔了声音，听不到他具体在喊什么，这让安德鲁很是不爽。
“这应该不是一个普通的梦，我是魔王，一般不会做梦。”
安德鲁暗暗想道，这时，他感应到办公室内的情况，越发不爽，开门走了进去。
安德鲁刚走进去，老板椅就转了过来，一个独眼光头黑人男沉声朝他问道：“这世上，真有天使？”
安德鲁面无表情的拿出手机，拨打警卫室电话：“上来两个保安，有人闯进我办公室，还有，报警，那家伙一看就知道不是什么好人。”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Fury comes to visit
"We are investigating."
Colson lied with a smile on his face. His look was very deceptive. Tony did not ask further questions. At this time, Pepper Pepper hurried in.
"Watch TV."
Pepper turned on the TV and turned to the Bugle TV channel. The host Jameson was introducing loudly: "According to the news obtained by this station, Tony Stark wore a ridiculous armor and went to war with the group director Obadiah at the Stark Group last night..."
While Jameson was speaking, the screen switched to last night's battle. The picture quality was quite clear, and you could even hear the conversation between Tony and Obadiah.
Tony frowned: "How could this happen? Colson, didn't you say it was solved?"
"The technical department has processed all the videos, and I don't know why this happened."
Colson hurriedly called Bugle TV to interrupt the program. Unfortunately, Bugle TV did not agree to the above request and continued to broadcast.
There is no doubt that this is Andrew's work, he wants to let the people know the truth, and at the same time, establish the credibility of Bugle TV - which will help collect souls in the future.
"As far as we know, the reason why Tony Stark and Obadiah went to war was because Obadiah had been selling weapons to terrorists for a long time. In addition, Tony Stark's attack was also arranged by Obadiah."
Jameson kept talking, and Tony complained: "Where did this guy come from? He knows more than me, the client."
While speaking, Tony threw the speech aside casually. It was no longer needed. Everyone knew that he was the Iron Man.
The TV station continued to broadcast the scene. The Peace Knights and the Fire Knights behind them all appeared, which was quite complete.
Finally, Jameson continued: “Many people said that the video they took last night disappeared inexplicably, and at the same time, some people warned them to shut up.
I have every reason to suspect that there is a special organization that is violating the public's right to privacy and information, and I will dig out this organization at all costs.
In addition, there are a lot of videos about last night on the Kuai Dou app. You are welcome to download them. "
After Jameson finished speaking, a QR code appeared on the screen. Pepper and Tony took out their mobile phones to scan the code at the same time. Coulson was speechless, do you want to be so cooperative?
Coulson said with a headache: "We have to prepare a new rhetoric."
"No, since it has been made public, let's tell the truth. Anyway, I didn't want to hide it."
Tony said: "From now on, I am Iron Man."
Colson hesitated for a moment and did not try to persuade him again. For some reason, he suddenly felt like a curtain was being opened.
The era of superheroes has officially arrived.
…
In the Rebirth Building, Andrew walked towards the office a little unhappy. As for Susan, she was still asleep because she was too tired last night.
The reason why Andrew was unhappy was not because he had to come to work, but because he had a strange dream last night.
In the dream, a little boy with an ever-changing face stood outside a glass-like barrier and kept yelling at him. He seemed very angry, but the glass blocked the sound and could not hear what he was shouting specifically. This made Andrew very unhappy.
"This shouldn't be an ordinary dream. I am the Demon King and I usually don't dream."
Andrew thought secretly. At this time, he sensed the situation in the office and became more and more unhappy. He opened the door and walked in.
As soon as Andrew walked in, the boss's chair turned around, and a one-eyed black man asked him in a deep voice: "Are there really angels in this world?"
Andrew took out his mobile phone expressionlessly and dialed the number of the guard room: "Two security guards came up. Someone broke into my office. Also, call the police. You can tell at a glance that that guy is not a good person."
